name: robi-robot
description: Robi, the NFC robot friend (English + Maltese)

scripts.android: npx cap add android && node scripts/setup-native.mjs android && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npx cap add ios && node scripts/setup-native.mjs ios && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.sync: node scripts/setup-native.mjs android && npx cap sync
